sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切实可行的方式把健康放在首位，而让我保持动力的一个神器就是我的WHOOP手环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我特别看重数据，这就是我喜欢WHOOP的原因，因为我能真正看清为什么我的身体在不同日子的感觉会有所不同，为什么我的跑步状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我的专注度可能没那么高。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能轻松追踪我的睡眠、体能消耗、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，还有我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供所有这些数据和规律，以便我能做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该加把劲。

sentences.zh: 一张照片、一件衣服、某个难忘地方的小纪念品。

sentences.zh: 在我的新播客《迷人》中，我和萨姆·托德一起探索那些成为我们生命一部分的记忆、痴迷和个人珍宝。

sentences.en: From the sublime all the way to the absolutely ridiculous, it's a fascinating deep dive into the keepsakes we hold close and the memories that make them special.
sentences.zh: 从高雅脱俗到绝对荒诞，这是一场引人入胜的深度探索，去探寻我们珍藏的纪念品以及赋予它们特殊意义的记忆。

sentences.zh: 这两个澳大利亚女人靠着个人魅力混入了英国上流社会，赢得了英国爱马仕精英们的青睐，甚至还见到了女王，而与此同时，她们却在诈骗人们的财富。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your Twenties, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s,
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《你二十岁的心理学》，这是一档带大家探讨我们二十岁时面临的一些重大生活改变和转折的播客，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及这些改变对我们的心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here.
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，很高兴能在这里见到你们。

sentences.en: Back for another episode as we, of course, break down the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听新的一期节目，在这里，我们理所当然地剖析着二十岁的心理学。

sentences.en: Okay, have you ever had that feeling, that sensation, that panic, that everybody is further ahead in their lives than you are?
sentences.zh: 好了，你有没有过那种感觉、那种知觉、那种恐慌，觉得身边所有人都比你混得好、走得远？

sentences.en: They are more successful.
sentences.zh: 他们更成功。

sentences.en: They are more sure of themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们更自信。

sentences.en: They are further along when it comes to their relationships, their finances,
sentences.zh: 无论是在人际关系、财务状况，

sentences.en: knowing what they want to do with their lives.
sentences.zh: 还是在明确自己想过怎样的人生方面，他们都走得更远。

sentences.en: This feeling of being behind is a really common one during this decade, during our 20s.
sentences.zh: 这种落后感在这个十年，也就是我们二十多岁的时候，是非常普遍的现象。

sentences.en: It is the norm, not the exception.
sentences.zh: 这是常态，而不是特例。

sentences.en: But I think despite that, it's also incredibly stressful and at times debilitating when we,
sentences.zh: 但我认为尽管如此，当我们处于以下情况时，它依然会带来难以置信的压力，有时甚至会让人崩溃：

sentences.en: A, don't have open conversations about it.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们没有就此展开公开的对话。

sentences.en: There isn't an acknowledgement of how many of us are feeling stuck in our lives.
sentences.zh: 大家并没有意识到我们当中有多少人正感到生活停滞不前。

sentences.en: And B, we constantly compare ourselves to the people who do have it all, feeling like everyone else is finding this whole life thing very easy whilst we're struggling.
sentences.zh: 第二，我们总是把自己和那些真正拥有一切的人作比较，觉得除了我们自己在苦苦挣扎之外，其他所有人把生活都过得轻松写意。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about it today.
sentences.zh: 所以我今天想聊聊这个。

sentences.en: I want to talk about why it is that we find ourself in this constant spiral, this constant self-doubt kind of cycle.
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊为什么我们会陷入这种无休止的螺旋、这种无休止的自我怀疑循环中。

sentences.en: No matter how much we do have, how much we have achieved, I think despite knowing that life is a journey, not a race, we still feel behind.
sentences.zh: 无论我们拥有多少，取得了多大的成就，我认为尽管知道人生是一场旅行而非赛跑，我们依然会觉得自己落后了。

sentences.en: But I think the real question is, like behind what?
sentences.zh: 但我觉得真正的问题是，这到底是落后于什么呢？

sentences.en: What is this invisible standard that we are all falling short of?
sentences.zh: 我们都在达不到的这个无形标准究竟是什么？

sentences.en: What exactly are we comparing ourselves to?
sentences.zh: 我们到底在和谁作比较？

sentences.en: And why does the success of other people and the accomplishments of other people sit so heavy on our minds and diminish our own sense of agency and our own progress?
sentences.zh: 为什么别人的成功和成就沉重地压在我们的心头，消磨了我们自己的自主意识和进步空间？

sentences.en: Well, that's really like the core of this discussion.
sentences.zh: 这其实就是本次讨论的核心。

sentences.en: This is such a common phenomena, feeling behind in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 在二十多岁时感到落后是一个极其普遍的现象。

sentences.en: And it's kind of ironic because if it is so common, how come we all experience it?
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点讽刺，既然这么普遍，为什么我们每个人都会经历？

sentences.en: Who are these like people who are not feeling behind?
sentences.zh: 那到底谁才是那些没有落后感的人？

sentences.en: Why is it that they are seen as what is normal?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们会被视为正常标准？

sentences.en: Why is it the people who are ticking everything off their bucket list, achieving all the necessary milestones, why are they the standard?
sentences.zh: 为什么那些把愿望清单上一条条打勾、达成所有必要里程碑的人，会成为标准？

sentences.en: I also want to share some of your experiences, the listeners.
sentences.zh: 我还想分享一些你们这些听众的经历。

sentences.en: A lot of you have kindly written in to me on Instagram and said that you feel similar and have kind of articulated why you're struggling.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人都在Instagram上亲切地留言给我，说你们也有同感，并详细诉说了你们挣扎的原因。

sentences.en: We have stories of being 30 and single, never having been in a relationship, another person who started their career again in their late 20s,
sentences.zh: 我们有30岁单身且从未谈过恋爱的人的故事，有在快到30岁时重新开始职业生涯的人，

sentences.en: people struggling with debt and decision making and job choices and not feeling like you can see a way forward.
sentences.zh: 还有那些在债务、决策、工作选择中苦苦挣扎，觉得看不到前路的人。

sentences.en: And of course, we're going to discuss why we feel that way, the psychology behind it and what we can do about it.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们要讨论为什么会有这种感觉，背后的心理学原理以及我们能做些什么。

sentences.en: How we can kind of just, you know, to be frank, stop feeling so shit about our own lives and our own progress.
sentences.zh: 我们该如何，坦白说，不再对自己的生活和进步感到那么糟糕。

sentences.en: How can we stop viewing our 20s as a race or a competition to get to this like imaginary finish line and just enjoy the personal journey, enjoy the scenic route,
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能不再把二十岁看作是一场通往虚构终点线的赛跑或竞争，而是去享受个人的旅程、风景优美的沿途路线，

sentences.en: enjoy what we want to get out of this decade.
sentences.zh: 去享受我们想从这个十年中收获的东西。

sentences.en: So there is obviously a lot to discuss alongside your very generous and vulnerable personal anecdotes.
sentences.zh: 所以，除了你们慷慨坦诚的个人轶事之外，显然还有很多内容需要讨论。

sentences.en: And my hope is that if you get one thing out of this episode today, it is that absolutely everybody is feeling behind or feeling lost or feeling stuck in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 我希望如果你能从今天的节目中有所收获，那就是绝对每个人在某种程度上都在感到落后、迷茫或停滞不前。

sentences.en: Even the people that you look to and compare yourself to who seem so much further ahead than us, they genuinely are feeling this as well.
sentences.zh: 甚至连那些你仰望、与之比较、看起来比我们领先得多的人，其实也真切地有着这种感觉。

sentences.en: Because I think that it isn't about what you do have.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为这与你拥有什么无关。

sentences.en: It isn't about what you have achieved.
sentences.zh: 这与你取得了什么成就无关。

sentences.en: It's about our mindset and our mindset towards competition, towards success, towards uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 这关乎我们的心态，我们对竞争、对成功、对不确定性的心态。

sentences.en: So we have a lot to discuss.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要讨论的事情很多。

sentences.en: I'm going to stop rambling.
sentences.zh: 我要停止唠叨了。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into feeling behind in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们切入正题，聊聊二十多岁的落后感。

sentences.en: We have a lot of opportunities to feel behind in our 20s because we have a lot of opportunities, not just for social comparison, but also for self-doubt.
sentences.zh: 我们在二十多岁有很多机会产生落后感，因为我们有太多机会去进行社会比较，同时也容易产生自我怀疑。

sentences.en: But I think for the first two decades of our lives, for the first 18 years at least, all of us are very much in step with each other.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得在人生的前二十年里，至少在前18年里，我们所有人基本上都是步调一致的。

sentences.en: You know, we are kind of all existing on an identical path.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们都活在一条完全相同的道路上。

sentences.en: Everybody who is our own age is doing the same things.
sentences.zh: 所有和我们同龄的人都在做同样的事情。

sentences.en: We're going to school.
sentences.zh: 我们在上学。

sentences.en: We're trying to hit the same milestones of graduating.
sentences.zh: 我们在努力达到毕业的相同里程碑。

sentences.en: We're at the same classes.
sentences.zh: 我们在同样的班级里。

sentences.en: We have the same life probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们有着同样的生活烦恼。

sentences.en: We are all working towards a common goal.
sentences.zh: 我们都在朝着一个共同的目标努力。

sentences.en: Everything feels very much in line.
sentences.zh: 一切都显得非常齐心协力。

sentences.en: There is limited opportunities for comparison when it comes to life progress.
sentences.zh: 在生活进度方面，进行比较的机会是有限的。

sentences.en: You know, you might be comparing yourself based on like looks or who's had their first kiss or, you know, silly things like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你可能只是根据外表、谁初吻过了之类无聊的事情来进行比较，

sentences.en: But in terms of like where you're at in your life and the progress that you're making towards your goals, if you even have any when you're that young,
sentences.zh: 但就你的人生处于什么阶段、你朝着目标取得了多少进展而言，如果你在那么年轻的时候甚至有目标的话，

sentences.en: that is all kind of very, very similar.
sentences.zh: 这些其实都非常非常相似。

sentences.en: And then we enter our 20s and suddenly it all splinters.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进入了二十岁，突然这一切都分崩离析了。

sentences.en: Our life paths become very, very different, very unique.
sentences.zh: 我们的人生道路变得非常非常不同，非常独特。

sentences.en: And that only is exacerbated the further along we get into our 20s and into this decade.
sentences.zh: 随着我们在二十多岁和这个十年中走得越远，这种差异就越发明显。

sentences.en: We're kind of no longer bustling alongside each other through mandatory schooling.
sentences.zh: 我们不再一起挤在义务教育的队伍里向前冲了。

sentences.en: We suddenly have freedom to choose and choose differently.
sentences.zh: 我们突然有了选择的自由，而且可以做出不同的选择。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of nuances in this.
sentences.zh: 这里面有很多微妙的差异。

sentences.en: One person wants to take a gap year.
sentences.zh: 一个人想去间隔年。

sentences.en: One person continues to work their high school job or their uni job to save up.
sentences.zh: 一个人继续做着高中或大学时的工作来存钱。

sentences.en: Another person speeds through their like four-year degree in three years and is like doing their master's by 23.
sentences.zh: 另一个人用三年时间读完了原本四年的学位，23岁就在读硕士了。

sentences.en: Somebody is going straight into a high-paying job after college.
sentences.zh: 有人大学毕业后直接进入高薪工作。

sentences.en: Somebody is having children, right?
sentences.zh: 有人开始生孩子，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like everybody is suddenly living in a different timeline compared to the common timeline that we used to have.
sentences.zh: 就像每个人突然都生活在不同的时间线上，打破了我们曾经共有的那个时间线。

sentences.en: And I think that it's at that point when everything splinters that it feels like a race suddenly begins.
sentences.zh: 我认为正是在一切分崩离析的那个时刻，一场赛跑仿佛突然开始了。

sentences.en: You know, it feels like we didn't realize we were at the starting line.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，感觉我们之前甚至没意识到自己站在起跑线上。

sentences.en: We didn't realize that suddenly it was going to be a competition, but implicitly it feels that way.
sentences.zh: 我们没意识到这突然变成了一场竞争，但潜意识里感觉就是这样。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the race to become real adults.
sentences.zh: 这有点像成为真正成年人的赛跑。

sentences.en: And in many ways, I think speaking to my friends, it feels like it's this race to enter our 30s or even like our mid-30s with a partner, with a successful and fulfilling career,
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，我觉得和朋友们聊天时，感觉这是一场赛跑：要在30多岁甚至35岁左右时，带着伴侣、带着成功且充实的事业，

sentences.en: with a really cushy savings account, with a bunch of friends, and also with enough fun experiences to kind of prove that although we got here, we still enjoyed ourselves
sentences.zh: 带着一笔相当可观的存款、一群朋友，以及足够多的有趣经历去证明，虽然我们走到了这里，但一路上我们依然享受了自我，

sentences.en: and enjoyed our lives along the way.
sentences.zh: 一路上享受了生活。

sentences.en: And we become a lot more aware of the people who are doing those things and the people who are not, which might be us, the people who are falling short.
sentences.zh: 而且我们变得更加注意到那些正在做这些事的人，以及那些没有做这些事的人——这可能就是我们，那些掉队的人。

sentences.en: I think the core reason we feel behind is obviously social comparison.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们感到落后的核心原因显然是社会比较。

sentences.en: Without the visibility of others and their life paths, we wouldn't have any reason to think that what we're doing is wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果看不到别人及其人生道路，我们就没有任何理由认为自己做错了什么。

sentences.en: We wouldn't have anybody to be behind because we would only be thinking about ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们就不会觉得自己落后于任何人，因为我们只会关注自己。

sentences.en: We would only be conscious of our own progress and what felt good for us.
sentences.zh: 我们只会意识到自己的进度以及什么对自己感觉良好。

sentences.en: But of course, we know that comparison is a very like human disease.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我们知道比较是一种非常像人类的疾病。

sentences.en: It's not even a disease, a human syndrome, a human trait.
sentences.zh: 甚至不是疾病，是一种人类综合征，一种人类特质。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's just not possible to not have that kind of going on in the back of your mind as such a social tribal species.
sentences.zh: 作为这样一个极具社交属性的部落物种，有时脑子里不由自主地产生这种想法是不可避免的。

sentences.en: What's really fascinating to me, if not ironic, is when I asked all of you people, my beautiful listeners, whether you feel behind as someone in your 20s,
sentences.zh: 对我来说真正吸引人甚至有些讽刺的是，当我问你们所有人，我那些可爱的听众，作为二十几岁的人你们是否感到落后时，

sentences.en: 80% of you out of almost 5,000 votes, probably more because I checked that only after it had been up for like, I don't know, 14 hours.
sentences.zh: 在近5000票中，有80%的人投了赞成票——可能更多，因为我查看时它才上线了大概，不知道，14个小时。

sentences.en: But 80% of you at 5,000 votes, so a significant sample size there, said yes, you are feeling behind.
sentences.zh: 但在5000票中有80%的人投了赞成，这是一个相当大的样本量，他们说是的，你们确实感到了落后。

sentences.en: There is something in your life that you're not satisfied with that you feel you should be further ahead or further along in regards to.
sentences.zh: 你们生活中有些事情是不满意的，觉得在某些方面自己应该走得更远或更快。

sentences.en: That's compared to 20% of you who I assume feel really comfortable with where you're at.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，只有20%的人我猜对现状感到非常自在。

sentences.en: Maybe you're secure, you're working on yourself, setting your own pace.
sentences.zh: 也许你很安心，在提升自我，按照自己的节奏前行。

sentences.en: You could also just be doing exceptionally well, which congratulations.
sentences.zh: 也可能你确实过得异常出色，那恭喜你。

sentences.en: But what I find fascinating about this is that feeling lost, feeling stuck, feeling unaccomplished, feeling behind is the norm.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这其中最迷人的是，感到迷茫、感到停滞不前、感到毫无成就、感到落后才是常态。

sentences.en: It is not only the norm, it is the majority.
sentences.zh: 它不仅是常态，而且是大多数。

sentences.en: It is the huge majority, 80%.
sentences.zh: 它是绝对的大多数，占了80%。

sentences.en: And I just think that it comes down to a lot of reasons, but because this generation is so much more competitive, but also yet again available for comparison, right?
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这归结于很多原因，其中一部分是因为这一代人竞争更加激烈，但同时也更容易进行比较，对吧？

sentences.en: Particularly through social media and LinkedIn and publicly available information, it's very easy to focus on everybody who has more than you
sentences.zh: 特别是在社交媒体、领英以及公开信息的时代，我们很容易把注意力集中在那些拥有比你更多的人身上，

sentences.en: and not the people who are just like you.
sentences.zh: 而忽略了那些和你一样的人。

sentences.en: The people who are doing really, really well for themselves, that 20%, maybe even that 10%, that 5%, they stand out.
sentences.zh: 那些过得非常非常不错的人，那20%，甚至那10%、5%，他们格外显眼。

sentences.en: And so our attention immediately goes to them.
sentences.zh: 因此我们的注意力瞬间就被他们吸引了。

sentences.en: Compared to the people who are doing life just like us in the same lane, that's not an interesting story.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，那些和我们一样在同一条轨道上过日子的人，并不是什么有趣的故事。

sentences.en: That's not going to capture our attention because we already know that narrative.
sentences.zh: 这不会吸引我们的眼球，因为我们已经知道那种生活剧本了。

sentences.en: We already know what that life looks like compared to the life of somebody that we want.
sentences.zh: 相比于我们渴望的那种生活，我们已经知道这种生活是什么样子的了。

sentences.en: We also can't ignore this implicit blueprint that society sets for our life that even if we don't believe in, we are still influenced by.
sentences.zh: 我们也不能忽视社会为我们的人生设定的隐性蓝图，即使我们不相信它，我们依然会受到它的影响。

sentences.en: So when we think about like society's blueprint for us, there is kind of this unspoken timeline of events.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们想到社会为我们准备的蓝图时，存在着一种不成文的事件时间线。

sentences.en: You graduate, maybe you go on and get your degree or some qualification.
sentences.zh: 你毕业，也许继续深造获取学位或某种资质。

sentences.en: You find your dream career.
sentences.zh: 你找到了理想的职业。

sentences.en: You get your job in that field.
sentences.zh: 你在那个领域找到了工作。

sentences.en: You make enough money to live independently.
sentences.zh: 你赚到足够的钱独立生活。

sentences.en: You find the love of your life.
sentences.zh: 你找到了此生挚爱。

sentences.en: You get promoted.
sentences.zh: 你升职了。

sentences.en: You buy a house.
sentences.zh: 你买了一栋房子。

sentences.en: You get married.
sentences.zh: 你结婚了。

sentences.en: You have children, retirement, death.
sentences.zh: 你生孩子，退休，死亡。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: That's what the blueprint tells us.
sentences.zh: 这就是蓝图告诉我们的内容。

sentences.en: And it's a very restrictive idea of what constitutes a happy life.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其狭隘的关于什么才算幸福生活的定义。

sentences.en: And it's also a very incomplete narrative, an incomplete blueprint because it doesn't include the stories of people who, you know, completely uproot their lives at 30 or 50.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个非常不完整的叙事，一个不完整的蓝图，因为它没有包含那些在30岁或50岁时彻底颠覆自己生活的人的故事。

sentences.en: The people who never get married or who never have kids.
sentences.zh: 那些从未结婚或从未生子的人。

sentences.en: The people who take a few years off between graduation and full-time work to explore.
sentences.zh: 那些在毕业和全职工作之间空出几年去探索的人。

sentences.en: The people who never find their dream job.
sentences.zh: 那些从未找到理想工作的人。

sentences.en: The people who, you know, these kind of milestones just aren't going to happen in the same way for them.
sentences.zh: 那些发现这些人生里程碑对他们而言根本不会按同样方式发生的人。

sentences.en: Those stories, the ones that I've just kind of given a few examples of, they're not the ones we hear about.
sentences.zh: 那些故事——我刚才只举了几个例子的那些——并不是我们经常听到的故事。

sentences.en: And so we don't think of them or include them in our own interpretation of how our lives should be going, how our lives should be progressing.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们不会想到它们，也不会把它们纳入我们对自己生活应该如何进行、生活应该如何发展的理解中。

sentences.en: When it comes to feeling behind, I believe that there are three major areas where we experience this the moSt.
sentences.zh: 说到感到落后，我认为我们在三个主要领域对此感受最深。

sentences.en: That is our careers, our relationships, and our finances.
sentences.zh: 那就是我们的职业、人际关系和财务状况。

sentences.en: Not only are these three of the most formative elements of our 20s, the things that I think we spend a lot of time worrying about,
sentences.zh: 这些不仅是我们20多岁时最具塑造力的三个元素，也是我认为我们花了很多时间去焦虑的事情，

sentences.en: but in some ways they're also quite visible, right?
sentences.zh: 但从某些方面来说，它们也是相当显而易见的，对吧？

sentences.en: We don't feel behind in terms of our health.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在健康方面感到落后。

sentences.en: We don't feel behind in terms of aging.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在衰老方面感到落后。

sentences.en: We don't feel behind in terms of our personal development.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在个人发展方面感到落后。

sentences.en: We feel behind based on things that we think that other people can see.
sentences.zh: 我们感到落后，是基于我们认为别人能够看到的事情。

sentences.en: So I think let's start with the biggest one that I heard from you all, which is career goals.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，让我们从你们所有人提到的最大一个问题开始，那就是职业目标。

sentences.en: I think this is the most common of the three because it feels like something that we really need to grow.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是这三者中最常见的一个，因为这感觉像是我们真正需要成长的事情。

sentences.en: And so the time we spend on it and the results feel like an investment.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在上面投入的时间以及产出的结果感觉就像是一种投资。

sentences.en: They feel very precious.
sentences.zh: 它们感觉非常珍贵。

sentences.en: Like when it comes to relationships, you could meet like the love of your life tomorrow and complete that part of your story.
sentences.zh: 比如在感情方面，你明天可能就会遇到一生所爱，从而完成你人生故事的那一部分。

sentences.en: But your career takes a little bit longer to establish and it feels very intentional.
sentences.zh: 但你的职业需要更长一点的时间来建立，而且感觉非常需要刻意为之。

sentences.en: So we put a lot of pressure on ourselves to get it right the first time around, to get it right straight out the gate because we don't want to spend like five years doing
sentences.zh: 所以我们给自己施加了很大压力，要求自己第一次就做对，一出社会就步入正轨，因为我们不想花大约五年的时间去做

sentences.en: something that we think we love or we think will be fulfilling.
sentences.zh: 一件我们以为自己热爱或以为会有成就感的事。

sentences.en: And then, you know, we hit 30 and it's like a waste of our time.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，等我们到了30岁，就会觉得是在浪费时间。

sentences.en: That's how we interpret it.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样解读的。

sentences.en: We have to start again.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不从头开始。

sentences.en: You know, we want to feel like we're doing things productively.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们希望觉得自己做的事情是有成效的。

sentences.en: We want to feel like we're making a contribution to our future.
sentences.zh: 我们希望觉得自己正在为自己的未来做出贡献。

sentences.en: And so I think that fear of not getting it right the first time, that fear of not knowing
sentences.zh: 所以我想，那种没有一开始就做对的恐惧，那种对未知和不确定的恐惧，

sentences.en: of uncertainty, it really keeps us in places, in industries, in careers, in fields, in jobs that we don't fully love because we don't want to sacrifice the security of experience
sentences.zh: 真的把我们困在了那些我们并非完全热爱的地点、行业、职业、领域和工作岗位中，因为我们不想牺牲经验带来的安全感

sentences.en: and have to start again.
sentences.zh: 而不得不从头再来。

sentences.en: We also don't want to feel like a failure, right?
sentences.zh: 我们也不想觉得自己是个失败者，对吧？

sentences.en: We don't want people to, you know, catch up with us and ask us, oh, how's work going?
sentences.zh: 我们不想让别人，你知道的，追上我们并问我们，哦，工作怎么样啦？

sentences.en: And be like, yeah, it's all right.
sentences.zh: 然后回答说，嗯，还行吧。

sentences.en: It's fine.
sentences.zh: 挺好的。

sentences.en: As if we should be doing more.
sentences.zh: 就好像我们本该做得更多一样。

sentences.en: As if we're wasting our time or wasting our lives doing something that we don't fully love and not even doing it at a high level compared to other people.
sentences.zh: 就好像我们在做一件并非完全热爱的事是在浪费时间或浪费生命，而且跟其他人相比甚至没有达到很高的水平。

sentences.en: So I asked you guys about this and I wanted to hear about your experience.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了大家这个问题，我想听听你们的经历。

sentences.en: Why do you feel behind in your career?
sentences.zh: 为什么你会在职业生涯中感到落后？

sentences.en: And here's what some of you had to say.
sentences.zh: 以下是你们当中一些人的看法。

sentences.en: This one I absolutely love.
sentences.zh: 这个我真的超级喜欢。

sentences.en: I'm coming up on one year post uni this May and I feel some sadness about it because I thought that I'd be further along by now.
sentences.zh: 今年5月，我大学毕业就快满一年了，对此我感到有些难过，因为我原本以为自己现在应该走得更远。

sentences.en: And the one year marker is just another reminder that I'm not.
sentences.zh: 而这满一年的时间节点只是又一次提醒我，我并没有。

sentences.en: After postgrad, it took me a while to find a job.
sentences.zh: 研究生毕业后，我花了一段时间才找到工作。

sentences.en: That is so common.
sentences.zh: 这太常见了。

sentences.en: Trust me.
sentences.zh: 相信我。

sentences.en: But when I did, it sounded great on paper working in a professional newsroom at the number one channel in the third biggest city in the US.
sentences.zh: 但当我找到时，纸面上听起来好极了，在全美第三大城市收视率第一的频道里担任专业新闻编辑室的工作。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Impressive.
sentences.zh: 令人印象深刻。

sentences.en: After a few months of giving it a shot, I made the decision to leave because my intuition was telling me I had to go and I don't regret it.
sentences.zh: 尝试了几个月后，我决定离开，因为我的直觉告诉我必须走，而且我不后悔。

sentences.en: And then my dad fell sick.
sentences.zh: 然后我爸爸生病了。

sentences.en: Better now.
sentences.zh: 现在好多了。

sentences.en: Oh, thank goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: That's always good to hear.
sentences.zh: 听到这个总是让人高兴。

sentences.en: Fast forward to now.
sentences.zh: 快进到现在。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm back to square one of the job search process.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己又回到了求职流程的原点。

sentences.en: And I'm debating if I should go back to school and pursue an entirely different field outside of media.
sentences.zh: 我正在纠结是不是应该重返校园，去追求一个完全脱离传媒领域的全新方向。

sentences.en: I feel shame about it, even though I think it is very normal to go through at this age.
sentences.zh: 我为此感到羞耻，尽管我认为在这个年龄经历这些非常正常。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for sharing.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的分享。

sentences.en: I feel like a lot of people can relate to that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很多人都能对此感同身受。

sentences.en: I'm also really glad that your dad is doing better.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴你爸爸身体在好转。

sentences.en: That's really good news.
sentences.zh: 真是个好消息。

sentences.en: I want to pick up on one thing that this person said, and it was around the feeling of shame.
sentences.zh: 我想接着这个人说的一点往下聊，那就是关于羞耻感。

sentences.en: I think that shame element, that shame factor is something that we really need to focus on because starting again or acknowledging that we aren't necessarily where we want to
sentences.zh: 我认为羞耻感的那个元素、羞耻因素是我们真正需要关注的，因为重新开始或承认我们并没有达到

sentences.en: be or imagined that we would be makes us feel in some way like we have failed, that we were not for it, that we weren't capable, that we made a huge mistake.
sentences.zh: 自己想要或想象中会达到的位置，在某种程度上让我们觉得自己失败了，觉得自己不够格，觉得自己没有能力，觉得自己犯了一个大错。

sentences.en: And shame has a lot of psychological origins.
sentences.zh: 羞耻感有很多心理学根源。

sentences.en: But one of the biggest ones is feeling like we have not lived up to the highest standards that we have set ourselves or our expectations.
sentences.zh: 但其中最大的根源之一，就是觉得自己没有达到我们为自己设定的最高标准或期望。

sentences.en: And therefore, we kind of deserve to feel bad.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们觉得自己活该感觉糟糕。

sentences.en: We deserve some kind of negative emotional consequence as kind of like a retribution for failing ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们理应承受某种负面情绪的后果，作为对辜负了自己的惩罚。

sentences.en: It's also really frequently linked in academic research to a sense of inadequacy, which if you are a long time listener, you know, is also related to being an overachiever, being a
sentences.zh: 在学术研究中，它也经常与无能感联系在一起，如果你是老听众，你就会知道，这也与追求完美、有完美主义倾向

sentences.en: perfectionist or being somebody who is quite anxious.
sentences.zh: 或者是比较焦虑的人有关。

sentences.en: Shame is a really common experience for the people that I've spoken to who, for example, have maybe taken a little bit longer to finish university, who have made a career change,
sentences.zh: 对于我交谈过的那些人来说，羞耻感是一种非常普遍的体验，例如，他们可能花了稍微长一点的时间才大学毕业，经历过职业转型，

sentences.en: who have had to spend a lot more time in those junior roles all over again.
sentences.zh: 或者不得不花更多的时间重新经历那些初级岗位。

sentences.en: The other big group of people who experience this are those of us who have been fired or laid off because we don't typically think about those situations when we're planning our
sentences.zh: 另一大类有这种体验的人是我们当中被解雇或裁员的人，因为我们在规划梦想生活时，通常不会去考虑那些情况，对吧？

sentences.en: dream life, right?
sentences.zh: 我有一些朋友最近经历了这些，这真的、真的是糟透了。

sentences.en: I've had a few friends who have gone through this recently and it's really, really shitty.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常令人沮丧的境况。

sentences.en: It's a really frustrating situation.
sentences.zh: 我想这是因为在那些情况下，尽管这不是我们所能控制的，但我们

sentences.en: And I think it's because in those situations, even though it's out of our control, we become
sentences.zh: 变得极其清晰地意识到，我们对未来的期望、对目前应处位置的设想与现实是多么的不符。

sentences.en: very acutely aware of how our expectation for the future and where we would be at now and our reality is not lining up.
sentences.zh: 而在某种更社交的层面上，我们会去关注我们认为别人可能会因为这段经历、因为被裁员而对我们产生怎样的看法，

sentences.en: And on some more social level, we focus on what we believe other people might assume about us because of that experience, because of being laid off, but also how everybody else is
sentences.zh: 同时也会关注其他人是如何继续存钱的、是如何继续取得进展的、是如何在简历上继续积累那些年资的，而我们在这方面的努力却被中断了。

sentences.en: continuing to save up money, is continuing to progress, is continuing to have those years of experience on their resume and our efforts at doing that have been cut short.
sentences.zh: 我认为记住这一点真的很重要：尽管你的职业很重要，但它并不是你身份或价值的唯一基础。

sentences.en: I think it's really important to remember that your career, whilst it is important, is not the sole basis of your identity or your worth.
sentences.zh: 除了做一份工作之外，还有很多很多事情能让你变得有趣、让你有所成就、让你成为一个优秀的人。

sentences.en: There is so much beyond what you do for a job that makes you interesting and makes you accomplished and makes you a good person.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为你到达自己想去的地方需要花更长一点的时间，并不意味着你在这一路上没有收获宝贵的东西。

sentences.en: Just because it's taking a little bit longer for you to be where you would like to be doesn't mean that you're not picking up valuable things along the way.
sentences.zh: 好了，让我们听听另一个人的看法，我认为这个人非常、非常完美地阐释了这一点。

sentences.en: Okay, let's hear from somebody else who I think really, really demonstrates this point.
sentences.zh: 我在25岁时上大学，大家都非常支持。

sentences.en: I went to uni at 25 and people were so supportive.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未接受过高等教育。

sentences.en: I'd never done higher education.
sentences.zh: 我在16岁时成为了一名美发师，并去旅行了几年。

sentences.en: I became a hairdresser at 16 and went traveling for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 所以这对当时的我来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: So this was huge for me.
sentences.zh: 然而，自从大学毕业后，我又重新回到了酒店餐饮业做全职，我觉得自己应该做得更多，应该明确自己的方向，应该有更多拿得出手的东西。

sentences.en: However, since finishing uni, I've stepped back into hospitality full time and I feel like I should be doing more, knowing my direction, have more to show for it.
sentences.zh: 别误会我的意思。

sentences.en: Don't get me wrong.
sentences.zh: 我热爱我的工作，而且我在职位上也取得了进展。

sentences.en: I love my job and I progressed position wise.
sentences.zh: 由于糟糕的住房情况，我最近还失去了积蓄。

sentences.en: I've also recently lost my savings due to a savage house situation.
sentences.zh: 我只看到27岁的每个人在财务、物质、感情上都拥有那么多，并且清楚自己人生的方向。

sentences.en: I just see everyone at 27 having so much more financially, materialistically, relationship wise and knowing their direction in life.
sentences.zh: 也许这只是一种看法，而且很大程度上也是从社交媒体的角度来看待的。

sentences.en: Maybe this is a perception and also massively from social media's perspective.
sentences.zh: 我也已经单身九年了。

sentences.en: I've also been single for nine years now.
sentences.zh: 所以在各个方面都感觉落后。

sentences.en: So in all departments feeling behind.
sentences.zh: 看吧，我认为这也是最艰难的地方，那就是恭喜你。

sentences.en: See, I think this is also the hard thing, which is congratulations.
sentences.zh: 就像你上了大学，你去接受了更高阶的教育。

sentences.en: Like you went to uni, you went and got like further education.
sentences.zh: 每个人都说那是促进和推动你职业及人生发展的最便捷途径。

sentences.en: Everyone says that that is like the easiest way to advance and move forward in your career and in your life.
sentences.zh: 但我们当中许多人并没有发现这一点，对吧？

sentences.en: But a lot of us are not finding that, right?
sentences.zh: 就像我们很多人都有用不上的学位，以及压在心头、沉甸甸的债务，

sentences.en: Like a lot of us have degrees that we don't use and debt that kind of just weighs very heavily
sentences.zh: 它限制了我们本来可以在生活中拥有的其他机遇，如果我们不必担心偿还贷款之类的事情，我们本可以开启这些机遇。

sentences.en: on our mind and restricts the other opportunities that we could have in our life that we could unlock if we didn't have to worry about paying back a loan or whatnot.
sentences.zh: 这里有另一个关于此事的视角，我非常喜欢。

sentences.en: Here's another perspective on this that I really liked.
sentences.zh: 我现在拥有我一生中想要的一切。

sentences.en: When I talk with friends who don't have these situations with their finances, I see that they're able to save for a house, go on fun, exotic trips, buy new cars, etc.

sentences.en: You could have your absolute dream job, which by the sounds of it, this person does.

sentences.en: They love what they're doing and still be struggling financially and feeling behind because of it.
sentences.zh: 我认为年纪越大，你就越会意识到，尽管很不幸，但如今金钱确实能使鬼推磨。

sentences.zh: 当你看到那些拥有更多的人似乎比我们以更快的速度享受生活、积累财产和积累回忆时，你很难忽视这个事实。

sentences.en: And it's really hard to ignore that fact when you see people who do have more seemingly enjoying

sentences.zh: 除了满足我们最基本的需求之外，我还想谈谈那种感觉：如果我们财务落后，如果我们储蓄落后，我们在未来享受生活的能力上也就落后了。

sentences.en: couldn't afford and that that regret is going to become more pronounced by seeing the people who do have it better, who were able to buy those things.
sentences.zh: 但我还是要说，在我们20多岁的时候，我们往往会认为我们现在赚的钱就是我们永远会赚的钱。

sentences.en: Money unlocks opportunity and it unlocks a life that we want.

sentences.en: I'm not going to go into a lecture around like money doesn't buy you happiness.

sentences.en: But I will say that in our 20s, we tend to think that the money we are making now is the money that we will be making forever.

sentences.zh: 我们的社会对单身存在很多偏见，但并不是每个人都能在二十几岁、三十几岁甚至四十几岁时找到真爱。

sentences.en: For some people, it really does take their whole lives and it doesn't mean that you are behind.
sentences.zh: 对某些人来说，这确实需要花费一生的时间，但这并不意味着你落后了。

sentences.en: Like without love, your life is empty.
sentences.zh: 就好像没有爱情，你的生活就是空虚的。

sentences.en: Without a partner, everything is glass half full.
sentences.zh: 如果没有伴侣，一切都显得悲观消极。

sentences.en: I don't think that we should buy into this misconception as well that a relationship is something that we need to tick off our to-do liSt.

sentences.zh: 它是我们自然而然坠入的情感。

sentences.zh: 如果成功了，那太棒了。

sentences.en: That is such great news.
sentences.zh: 这真是个好消息。

sentences.en: But if it doesn't, that's all right.

sentences.en: and who, you know, experience insane transformative growth at the end of a relationship that completely pushes them into a new chapter in their life.

sentences.zh: 生子的人，有时这种害怕自己跟不上他们、被他们

sentences.zh: 至少你满足了社会对你二十多岁时关于伴侣关系和寻找真爱的要求。

sentences.en: It's a really hard feeling to not have that.

sentences.en: And it's possibly an even worse feeling to never have experienced love or really know what all the hype is about, to not have even had your first kiss, your first girlfriend,

sentences.zh: 但你知道的，她花时间去了解自己。

sentences.en: She had the experiences with people that, you know, didn't work out.
sentences.zh: 她有过那些你知道的无疾而终的人际交往经历。

sentences.en: She had time to make beautiful, fulfilling friendships, to move cities, to do all those things.
sentences.zh: 她有时间去结交美好、充实的友谊，搬去不同的城市，去体验所有这些事情。

sentences.en: And she ended up in this like incredible relationship with this amazing person.
sentences.zh: 最终她收获了一段与这位优秀之人的不可思议的美好恋情。

sentences.en: And she said something really profound, which is that she looks back at it now and she can appreciate that it was hard, but it really felt quite worth it.
sentences.zh: 她说过一句非常深刻的话：如今回想起来，她虽然能体会到当年的不易，但这一切真的非常值得。

sentences.en: So there's another example.
sentences.zh: 所以这又是一个例子。

sentences.en: And, you know, because we're on a bit of a roll, I'm also going to include my mom in this as somebody who you can think of and feel better about yourself.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，既然我们正顺势聊着，我也要把我妈妈当作一个例子讲进来，你可以想想她，从而对自己的现状感觉好一点。

sentences.en: When she was in her 20s, she literally got kicked out of like every single course that she did.
sentences.zh: 在她20多岁的时候，她几乎被她上的每一门课程都劝退过。

sentences.en: She failed her first degree.
sentences.zh: 她的第一个学位挂科了。

sentences.en: She was asked to leave by her old university faculty.
sentences.zh: 她被以前的大学系里要求离开。

sentences.en: She was working at a restaurant for years whilst her friends, you know, got scholarships and became doctors and nurses.
sentences.zh: 她曾在一家餐馆打工多年，而与此同时，她的朋友们拿到了奖学金，成为了医生和护士。

sentences.en: But she took her time.
sentences.zh: 但她按自己的节奏来。

sentences.en: And when she felt ready, she went back to university.
sentences.zh: 当她觉得自己准备好了，她就回到了大学。

sentences.en: She's now a CEO.
sentences.zh: 她现在是一名首席执行官。

sentences.en: She now literally runs a company.
sentences.zh: 她现在真真正正地经营着一家公司。

sentences.en: She is like an incredible woman.
sentences.zh: 她就像一个了不起的女性。

sentences.en: She raised three daughters.
sentences.zh: 她抚养了三个女儿。

sentences.en: She has like an army of beautiful, beautiful friends.
sentences.zh: 她有一大群非常非常要好的朋友。

sentences.en: And she's really successful.
sentences.zh: 而且她真的很成功。

sentences.en: And I'm sure that when she was in that phase where it wasn't working out, where all she could think was about her failures and everything that hadn't been a success, she wouldn't
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定，当她处于那种诸事不顺的阶段，脑子里只想著自己的失败以及所有没有成功的事情时，她肯定

sentences.en: have been able to picture where she is now.
sentences.zh: 无法想象自己现在能站在这样的高度。

sentences.en: I think we really need to start glamorizing and sharing the success stories of people who didn't have it straightforward and reminding ourselves that just because it's taking a bit
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们真的需要开始美化并分享那些经历并非一帆风顺的人的成功故事，并提醒自己：仅仅因为事情进展得慢了一点，

sentences.en: longer doesn't mean you won't get there eventually.
sentences.zh: 并不意味着你最终不会到达终点。

sentences.en: And even if you don't get to where you imagined you would be in the time that you wanted to do it, you can still feel happy in whatever circumstances you find yourselves in.
sentences.zh: 而且，即使你没有在你想达成的时间里到达你想象中的地方，无论你发现自己身处何种境地，你依然可以感到幸福。

sentences.en: I want to remind you of just the resilience of humans and the fact that people find great joy and great strength and something to live for and beauty and excitement, even in
sentences.zh: 我想提醒你们记住人类的韧性，记住人们即使在绝境中也能找到巨大的快乐、巨大的力量、生活的意义、美丽与兴奋，

sentences.en: situations that they never could have anticipated.
sentences.zh: 哪怕这些情况是他们做梦也想不到的。

sentences.en: So even if it isn't going according to plan, it doesn't mean that the end result isn't going to be amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使事情没有按计划进行，也不意味着最终的结果不会惊艳。

sentences.en: There's one final thing I want to say on this, and it's actually a quote.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，我还有最后一点想说，其实这是一句名言。

sentences.en: And I actually saw it on Reddit when I was doing some investigating for this episode.
sentences.zh: 我在为这期节目做调查时，其实是在红迪网（Reddit）上看到的。

sentences.en: And it was a very well-known quote, which is that youth is wasted on the young.
sentences.zh: 这是一句非常著名的名言，那就是：青春被挥霍在年轻人身上。

sentences.en: I think this exact situation we're talking about goes to demonstrate that quite well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们现在讨论的这种情况，正好很好地证明了这一点。

sentences.en: A lot of people who are in their mid-30s, late 30s now, early 40s, all look back at their
sentences.zh: 许多现在处于30岁中期、30岁后期、以及40岁初期的很多人，回首他们的

sentences.en: 20s and think, oh my God, why was I so worried?
sentences.zh: 20多岁时都会想，天哪，我当年到底在焦虑什么？

sentences.en: You know, I think we have a lot of hype around doing it all in this decade.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我觉得我们周围有太多鼓吹要在十年里把所有事情都做完的论调。

sentences.en: But this is when we're making the least amount of money.
sentences.zh: 但偏偏这是我们赚钱最少的时候。

sentences.en: We feel very stuck.
sentences.zh: 我们感到非常迷茫。

sentences.en: We're not completely sure of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们对自我并不是完全确定。

sentences.en: All the experiences that we should be having are wasted on us because we don't know how to appreciate them.
sentences.zh: 我们本该拥有的所有经历都被我们挥霍了，因为我们不懂得如何去欣赏它们。

sentences.en: We don't have the hindsight of knowing that it's all going to work out.
sentences.zh: 我们没有那种知道一切都会好起来的后见之明。

sentences.en: So trust our elders, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以，我猜我们还是相信前辈们的话吧。

sentences.en: Trust the people that have come before us who say time and time again, don't worry too much.
sentences.zh: 相信那些走在我们前面的人，他们一次又一次地说：别太担心。

sentences.en: It's all going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: I feel like when I think about their experiences and their advice, it always brings me a real sense of inner peace.
sentences.zh: 每当我想到他们的经历和建议，总是能带给我一种真正的内心平静感。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening to this episode.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家收听本期节目。

sentences.en: If you have made it this far, please DM me on Instagram and I'm going to send you a big fat love heart to say thank you for putting up with my rambling.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到了这里，请在Instagram上给我发私信，我会送你一个大大的爱心，谢谢你包容我的絮絮叨叨。

sentences.en: I know that this episode is a little bit different to what we usually do.
sentences.zh: 我知道这期节目跟我们平时做的有点不太一样。

sentences.en: I loved being able to incorporate some of your anecdotes, some of your experiences and just be a little bit more fluid with it.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢能把你们的一些趣闻轶事、你们的一些经历融入进来，让节目呈现得更随性灵动一些。

sentences.en: I appreciate you listening this far.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你一直听到这里。

sentences.en: And if you did enjoy this episode, please feel free to give the podcast a five-star review on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, wherever you are listening right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实喜欢这期节目，请随时在Apple Podcasts、Spotify或你现在收听节目的任何平台上给播客一个五星好评。

sentences.en: Make sure you're following or you're subscribed based on what platform you're listening and
sentences.zh: 根据你收听的平台，确保你点击了关注或订阅，

sentences.en: share this episode with a friend who you think might also be feeling a little bit stuck, feeling a little bit behind, feel like a problem shared is a problem halved.
sentences.zh: 并把这期节目分享给一个你认为也可能感到有些迷茫、有些掉队的朋友，因为说出来分享出去就是把痛苦减半。

sentences.en: And it probably will make every person in that situation feel a little bit less alone and take the pressure off, take the foot off the gas for a little while.
sentences.zh: 这很可能会让身处那种境地的每个人都觉得没那么孤单，从而减轻压力，暂时把脚从油门上拿下来休息一下。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Until next episode, stay safe and be kind and we'll talk soon.
sentences.zh: 直到下一期节目，请注意安全，保持善良，我们很快再聊。

sentences.zh: 这是一档iHeart播客。

sentences.zh: 真人保证。
